description: The current open-web sweep comprises 23 captured original search actions and 647 ordered result headers. It is a first pass, not an exhaustive archive review; national, local, labor, language, and issue-specific coverage remain uneven.
required_followup: Continue regionally varied Japanese and other relevant language searches and organizer/event-calendar review; document each original action and preserve ordered headers.

description: Search results report 46-city Flower Demo actions on February 11, but do not establish a simultaneous national crowd or city-level attendance.

description: For Japan-based Myanmar diaspora actions, captured results vary in whether they identify a demand directed at Japan. The February 3 Tokyo rally explicitly sought tougher Japanese action, and the February 7 Osaka result says demonstrators wanted Tokyo to intervene; for the February 28 Osaka lead the result only says it opposed Myanmar’s coup. Other gatherings still need event-level target verification.
required_followup: Read the exact event reports and distinguish demands made to Japan from opposition addressed only to Myanmar’s military government; do not infer the target from venue or organizer location.

description: Attendance for the February 7 and 11 JOC demonstrations, February 12 Olympics-cancellation protest, February 17 immigration-law action, February 21 anti-racist action, and the announced anti-Kigensetsu lead remains unresolved. S023, published February 16, 2022, reports 96 at a February 11 assembly but does not state its year; contextual references are consistent with 2022, so it does not establish a February 2021 crowd or a separate march count.
required_followup: Verify whether the announced 2021 anti-Kigensetsu action occurred and seek year-specific event reporting and attendance; do not assign S023’s 96 attendees to it. Locate event-day reporting or after-action records for the remaining leads and keep assembly and procession counts separate.

description: One current-unit body read is documented for S023, a 2022-published, year-unstated February 11 report that cannot verify E008 in February 2021. Three physical body requests were made across two URLs: JRCL twice (the first wrapper returned no text blocks; the second returned the readable article) and Note once (Cache miss). The earlier Note access gate did not result in a page request. The two unsuccessful requests are technical retrieval gaps, not denials; other source cards remain search_only.
required_followup: For each future body request, obtain a fresh exact-URL receipt and complete saved publisher/origin manual review, then immediately recheck the full input paths and hashes. Review the receipt and read-scope record before relying on any body.

description: Search results do not describe event-specific arrests, dispersal, state engagement, injuries or violence. All state-response and protester-violence variables remain unknown.
required_followup: Only code a response or violence when opened source evidence attributes it to that specific gathering; otherwise preserve unknown.

description: The end dates, duration and post-February continuation of candidate gatherings are not established. Search results mainly identify single-day actions or planned dates.

description: For the February 11 JOC action, February 21 Shinjuku anti-racist action, February 23 Osaka opposition action, February 28 Osaka diaspora lead, and the announced February 11 anti-Kigensetsu lead, captured results do not establish each demand’s exact state target.
